# Host Today

Act as the organizer command centre: show the live or next event, surface every authoritative time-sensitive task inside the policy horizon, and route the host to the safest immediate action.

## Ownership

- Primary route: `hostTodayScreen` (`/host/today`)
- Target root: `lib/hosts/today`
- Migration status: implemented as a destination-owned vertical slice
- Responsibility contract updated: 2026-09-22

Current implementation roots:

- `lib/hosts/today`

## This feature owns

- Own the /host/today route, its authentication and organizer-selection states, and its provider-free body composition.
- Fetch the bounded active-event context independently of the Events inventory controller.
- Consume the manager-authorized attention callable, parse exhaustive coverage, and merge device-local attendance retry or conflict work.
- Order work by urgency, consequence, deadline, and stable identity without inferring mandatory tasks from missing optional data.
- Own the dedicated Dress Rehearsal entry point and typed handoffs to Events, Event Manage, Audience Responses, Inbox, and Payouts.
- Keep incomplete attention sources visible so the screen cannot claim a false all-clear.

## This feature does not own

- The durable event inventory, history pagination, event creation internals, or event-management mutations.
- CRM segmentation, form authoring, messaging workflows, organizer settings, payout onboarding behavior, or rehearsal runtime internals.
- A generic notification feed or speculative reminders derived from null setup fields, unread messages, aggregate counts, or zero staff grants.

## Routes

Owned routes:

- `hostTodayScreen` — `/host/today`

Typed handoffs:

- `hostEventsScreen` — `/host/events`
- `hostAppEventManageScreen` — `/host/organizers/:clubId/events/:eventId/manage`
- `hostApplicationDetailScreen` — `/host/audience/applications/:applicationId`
- `hostAudienceScreen` — `/host/audience`
- `hostInboxScreen` — `/host/inbox`
- `hostOrganizerPaymentsScreen` — `/host/organizers/payments`
- `hostEventRehearsalStartScreen` — `/host/organizers/:clubId/rehearsals/new`

## Shared dependencies

- `lib/contexts/events/data/event_repository.dart` — Shared canonical event reads; Today owns only its bounded projection.
- `lib/contexts/bookings/data/host_attendance_outbox.dart` — Device-local absolute attendance operations are intentionally merged after the server projection.
- `lib/routing/shell/host_app_shell.dart` — The shell owns global destination navigation and organizer scope.
